discourse.title: Peace through Seva
discourse.excerpt: Man is perpetually engaged in the search for peace. The seeker of peace must search for it not in matham (religion) but in manam (the mind).
discourse.theme: Peace is not found outside — the seeker must search for it not in religion but in the mind itself.

reflection: Swami corrects the usual search: peace is not a place, a ritual or an external change, but a state of the mind to be established within first. Today, spend five quiet minutes calming the mind before you act — one calm reply instead of a reactive one is peace beginning within. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 20, 24 Nov 1987)
seva_nudge: Bring peace to one tense situation today — listen fully before answering, and offer a calm, kind word where a sharp one is expected.
